title: Can a labelled neighbour supply the label?
compared: For each labelled job, an earlier failure of the same module in another scenario that already had a ticket reference: how often that neighbour's class equals the job's label, against the posted comment's class on the same jobs.
sample: Public jobs: a pilot of 40 (20 gold, 20 silver), then all 383 gold and firm silver jobs; a job had a median of 188 candidate jobs.
verdict: The pilot passed its bar: at least 8 of 40 jobs with a neighbour, and for at least 80% of them some neighbour with the job's class. On all jobs 56% had a neighbour, but some neighbour matched for only 38% of them and the nearest one for 32%, against the 80% asked, and never on silver infrastructure jobs. Dropped.
